thesis: The episode argues that as AI makes software easier to build, real differentiation is moving up the stack to design, craft, point of view, and brand, making those skills essential for winning in a competitive era. It also contrasts the slow, multi-year build of Figma with the current frenetic pace of AI startups, suggesting that while founders should not replicate the slow build, they should look beyond just AI companies to find valuable opportunities.
